parameters.title: What it is.
parameters.subtitle: A line more.
parameters.leading: A glyph or a picture at its start.
parameters.trailingText: A value at its end, in the muted ink.
parameters.selected: Whether it is the row shown beside the list.
parameters.showChevron: Controls the directional indicator at the end of the row.
parameters.isDestructiveAction: Marks the row as a destructive action.
parameters.semanticLabel: What a screen reader calls it, when not its title.
